fields.label: School
fields.description: The school this KRA registration belongs to. Each school has one tax profile.

fields.label: Registered Name
fields.description: The name exactly as it appears on the school's KRA PIN certificate. Filled from the school; change it if KRA has a different name.

fields.label: KRA PIN
fields.description: 11 characters: P or A, nine digits, then a letter (for example P051234567X). A draft can be saved without it.

fields.label: KRA Branch ID
fields.description: The eTIMS branch the school's invoices are issued from, usually 00 for the head office.

fields.label: eTIMS Connection
fields.description: Manual: tax invoices are prepared here and filed by the school. The other modes need a certified provider set up by Stemic.

fields.label: Usual VAT Treatment
fields.options:
Review Required
Exempt
Zero Rated
Standard Rated
fields.description: What the school's sales usually are. Education is normally Exempt. Each invoice is still reviewed.

fields.label: Ready for Tax Invoices
fields.description: Tick once the PIN and branch are confirmed. Only then can tax invoices be prepared for this school.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Anything the next person should know, for example where the PIN certificate is kept.
